title: Session: Launch-scope ledger, authorization, and role transitions
objective: Validate version 2.12.3 queue logging plus the ledger, officer authorization, assignment, role-removal, and Guest grant/revoke paths that go live at production cutover. Guest forms and onboarding changes are out of scope.
user: Deploy 2.12.3 (no migration) with a stopped-writer backup and command registration, then run `/config validate`.
Ledger: `/ledger initialize`, deposit as a member, withdraw and adjust as an officer, then check `/ledger balance` and paged `/ledger history`.
As a non-officer, try `/ledger withdraw`, `/ledger adjust`, `/assign`, and `/config`; each must be refused.
As an officer, `/assign` a character to a test user, then `/unassign` it; Member or Guest should follow the link.
Remove an FC member's last link and confirm Member is removed; hand-add Member to an ineligible user and confirm drift repair.
`/guest revoke` then `/guest grant` a test user; revocation must survive `/refresh`.
assistant: Confirm expected queue waits log at debug, lost leases at warn, and reconcile results keep applied role deltas across supersession.
Record ledger entry IDs and balances, authorization denials, role transitions, and any blocked or failed work.
bot: Run compiled version 2.12.3 on schema 004, logging job outcomes by severity with timing and cause.
Apply each ledger decision exactly once with ordered notifications, and enforce officer and owner authorization.
Reconcile Member/Guest removals and manual drift authoritatively while preserving unrelated roles.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in the configured development channel.
